components.name: Stale Banner
components.description: The feed-loss state: frozen truth, explicit age, re-arming endpoint.

narrative.overview: The fleet is terrain. A dark survey sheet applies level lines, spot heights, grid references, and a marginal scale to live GPU/KV/session telemetry, with a cream day sheet that inverts the same roles. The standard ops shell keeps controls familiar; the world enters through type, palette, density, and the Fleet Profile. The header uses the approved B3 Flow custom outlined SVG symbol and custom-path wordmark, selected for the active theme and displayed at 30px high. Its four brand colors identify the product only and never encode survey or telemetry status. Every figure carries its source: router, engine, device, or est. Stale data freezes and says so; missing engine data is hatched, never guessed.
keyCharacteristics: Dark olive-ink survey sheet + paired cream day sheet
Sand level lines, water KV, moss live, amber estimate, vermilion failure
Overpass + Overpass Mono; integer 2px type steps; tabular figures
B3 Flow custom SVG logo; theme-selected asset, 30px high, brand colors identifier-only
Zero radius, 1px rules, no ambient shadow or glow
Fleet Profile is the only history chart; live sessions sit beside it
Frozen truth on feed loss, explicitly labelled stale

rules.name: The Source Rule
rules.body: Every figure carries router, engine, device, or est. A number without a source is a lie about the data.

rules.name: The One Failure Rule
rules.body: Vermilion is failure only. A 429 stays water; a stale feed and a saturated pool are the only other failures.

rules.name: The Integer-Step Rule
rules.body: Type sizes use only 10/12/14/16/24/28; line heights 12/16/20/28/32. No fractional sizes.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Every measured figure is mono and tabular; a ticking value never shifts its neighbours.

rules.name: The Flat-Sheet Rule
rules.body: No ambient shadow, glow, glass, or gradient. Depth is the 1px rule, the water fill, and the panel gaps.

rules.name: The No-Data Rule
rules.body: Nulls break the line and hatch the lane. Never interpolate between backends or forward-fill a gap.

dos: Put live sessions beside the profile in the first viewport.
Label every figure router, engine, device, or est.
Keep the Fleet Profile as the only history chart.
Hatch missing data and break lines at nulls.
Freeze the last truth on feed loss and label it stale.
Use tabular mono and integer 2px type steps.
donts: Don't use sand as decoration; it is the survey level line.
Don't add shadows, glows, gradients, glass, or rounded corners.
Don't use serif or italic type.
Don't reintroduce KPI cards, sparkline tiles, or a second chart style.
Don't present the router GPU budget as device utilization.
Don't show a stale engine's retained gauges as current.
Don't forward-fill history or claim uncovered percentiles.
